supplied_report.conclusion: Active decisions reached the 15 Hz target. The retained trace does not identify the reported own goal or last-second shot redirect precisely enough to establish a cause.

kernel_benchmark.runtime: Cloud Luau CLI; not Windows or JJSploit

changes: Deadline scheduling instead of resetting timers at each frame; missed slots are not replayed
Exact four-row dense kernel; no quantization or weight changes
Skip discarded inference during far ground overrides and recovery; retain near-ball actor jump decisions
Reuse travel integration across ground interception candidates
Scripted teammate yielding defaults off and optional yielding requires active, aligned approach
Retain active-run trace while paused and capture separate phase timings and latest pose
Prioritize requested pitch/yaw on jumps despite lingering wheel-contact estimates; omit Shift during jumps
Require observed direction-key state before a new jump edge; cancel or time out deferred jumps safely
Report intended and mapped jump actions, observed keys and direction-delivery wait time
Draggable paused window and F4 minimize/restore during active play
Nine-point manual goal calibration with collision-box support/offset correction, consistency checks, explicit Apply and local Save/Load
Separate passive twenty-second manual motion test; only consistent isolated-flight gravity can be applied
Conservative straight ground own-goal push veto and uncontested clean low roll-in protection; forecast post/wall bounces and reachable cars prevent clear-shot override
Use fitted goal planes and opening dimensions for goal guards and optional ground planner; preserve actor observations, masses and analytic world collision profile
F9 incident marker retains up to two recent eight-second trace windows
Identify unique source car dimensions even when hidden hitbox transform is stale; keep source-offset fallback explicit
Flying crossbar calibration: bounded F10-armed impact capture instead of an impossible stationary nose-up pose; retain stillness checks for ground landmarks
limits: Measured cloud speedups do not guarantee a particular FPS, decision rate or win rate on the user PC.
The actor receives approximate rendered state, estimated opponent boost/flip availability and a bounded pad subset.
Disabling our teammate-yield override does not retrain the learned actor or remove teammates from observations.
Static landmarks cannot identify car/ball masses, contact restitution or all handling parameters. Manual contact scatter and the assumed rounded profile limit accuracy.
The goal guards cover selected low ground situations; they cannot guarantee goals or prevent every own goal. Future touches and server corrections remain uncertain.
The frozen actor does not consume custom goal geometry; measured goal overrides apply to the guards and optional ground planner only.

jump_mapping.limits: Default keyboard bindings, pitch inversion off and aerial safety off. Reproduced mapping defect; no live validation that it caused the reported flip or goal misses.

goal_safety_benchmark.runtime: Cloud Luau CLI; not Windows or JJSploit
goal_safety_benchmark.limits: Synthetic fixed states; active reports record safety_ms separately to measure actual runtime cost.

calibration.rear_wall_samples: Validate and export net layout; not a fit of the full curved collision surface.

crossbar_capture.mode: Arm with F10, then fly nose-up into the underside near mouth centre
crossbar_capture.impact_check: Abrupt vertical velocity loss beyond ordinary gravity; highest box support around candidate contact
crossbar_capture.limits: Rendered sampling and smoothing limit height accuracy; soft impacts may not register; not a server collision event.
